paper_metadata.title: Effects of elastic intramedullary nails composed of low Young's modulus Ti-Nb-Sn alloy on healing of tibial osteotomies in rabbits
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Biomedical Materials Research Part B: Applied Biomaterials

evidence.quote: Two types of intramedullary nails composed of b-type Ti-Nb-Sn alloy (Young's modulus: 37 GPa) or Ti-6Al-4V alloy (Young's modulus: 110 GPa) were used for osteotomy fixation in the tibiae of rabbits.
Two types of intramedullary nails composed of b-type Ti-Nb-Sn alloy (Young's modulus: 37 GPa) or Ti-6Al-4V alloy (Young's modulus: 110 GPa) were used for osteotomy fixation in the tibiae of rabbits.

evidence.section: Preparation of intramedullary nails composed of Ti-Nb-Sn alloy and Ti-6Al-4V alloy
evidence.quote: Two kinds of titanium alloys, our recently developed Ti-33.6Nb-4Sn alloy (nominal composition in mass%) and the commercially available Ti-6Al-4V extra-low interstitial alloy, were used in this study.
